analysis.rationale: Strong operational performance with double-digit growth in pre-sales and collections, plus significant land acquisitions, indicating robust demand and future revenue visibility.
analysis.summary: Puravankara reports 28% YoY growth in pre-sales to ₹1,439 crore, 40% surge in collections to ₹1,199 crore, and adds ₹5,200 crore GDV pipeline in Q1 FY27.
